critical_code_review_comments: safeHtml.js CONFIG allows <a> without forcing rel='noopener noreferrer' or target sanitation — consider ADD_ATTR hook: `DOMPurify.addHook('afterSanitizeAttributes', node => { if (node.tagName==='A' && node.getAttribute('target')==='_blank') node.setAttribute('rel','noopener noreferrer nofollow'); })` to harden tab-nabbing.
CONFIG allows src but no explicit protocol restriction — DOMPurify blocks javascript:/data:text/html by default, but consider ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP to whitelist https/data:image only.
The unused `safeHtml()` helper (returns spread object) is exported but never used in the codebase; consider using it to reduce boilerplate at every call site.
DynamicLegalPage /informativa-privacy-pazienti returning 404 template should be investigated — unrelated to XSS fix, but user-facing legal route appears broken.
